papers.title_en: Feasibility of Simultaneous Input-Output Constraints for Tracking in a Class of LTI Systems: Part I
papers.authors: Junhyeok Yoon, Heather Hussain, Anuradha M. Annaswamy
papers.evidence: 线性时不变系统跟踪的输入输出约束
papers.tldr: 本文研究了线性时不变（LTI）系统在状态反馈和积分作用下，同时满足输入与输出约束的控制问题。作者提出了一种基于控制障碍函数（CBF）的调节器，推导了保证闭环系统解的有界性和前向不变性的充要条件，并给出了系统化的参数设计流程，为复杂约束下的轨迹跟踪提供了理论支撑。
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the problem of simultaneous satisfaction of input and output constraints for LTI systems with multiple inputs with state feedback and integral action using a Control Barrier Function based governor. Necessary and sufficient conditions for the CBF-based governor to have a feasible solution and for the closed-loop solutions to be bounded and forward-invariant are derived. A systematic design procedure for choosing the free parameters of the CBF-governor is also provided. These free parameters are associated with high-order CBFs, bounds on feasible command signals, and control input magnitude. A companion paper provides several numerical examples to illustrate the results of this paper, especially the feasibility (or infeasibility) of the CBF governor when the conditions are satisfied (or not satisfied).

papers.title_en: Model-Based Disturbance Rejection via Sliding-Mode Control: Continuous-Time Formulation and Proper Implicit Discretization
papers.authors: Benedikt Andritsch, Stefan Koch, Jaime A. Moreno
papers.evidence: 用于线性时不变系统扰动抑制的滑模控制
papers.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于模型干扰抑制的鲁棒精确滑模控制方法，用于实现参考轨迹跟踪。该方法将内部模型原理嵌入滑模控制器，通过模拟鲁棒精确微分器的误差动力学，确保了系统在有限时间内收敛。此外，作者开发了一种保持稳定性和精度的隐式离散化方案，适用于采样数据实现，并在理论上证明了其在干扰模型下的最优控制精度。
papers.abstract_en: We propose a robust exact sliding-mode controller for reference tracking with model-based disturbance rejection, where the disturbance is generated by a linear time-invariant model driven by a bounded input and may be bidirectionally coupled with the plant. The controller embeds the internal model principle and its error dynamics mirror those of the robust exact differentiator, ensuring finite-time convergence. We develop a proper implicit discretization for sampled-data implementation that preserves stability and accuracy. In the nominal case, which contains a disturbance generated by a $p$-th order integrator chain, the method achieves a control accuracy of $T^{p+1}\bar D$, with discretization time $T$ and disturbance bound $\bar D$. This accuracy is shown to relate to the fundamental lower bound by a factor depending only on the order of the disturbance model. Simulations demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed methods.

papers.title_en: MagLearn 2: High-Fidelity, Saturation-Aware, and History-Efficient Sequence-to-sequence Modeling of Transient B-H Behaviour Under PWM Excitation
papers.authors: Jingrong Yang, Binyu Cui, Yuming Huo, Lizhong Zhang, Alfonso Martinez, Song Liu, Jun Wang
papers.evidence: PWM励磁下磁性材料的B-H建模
papers.tldr: 针对PWM激励下磁性材料瞬态B-H行为建模难题，本文提出了MagLearn 2框架。该方法利用短窗口LSTM结合饱和感知辅助模块，实现了高保真度的磁场响应预测。研究通过灵敏度分析揭示了磁滞历史对预测的关键影响，并在MagNet Challenge II中以2.2%的平均RMSE刷新了序列预测任务的性能记录。
papers.abstract_en: Accurate transient B-H modeling under pulsewidth-modulated (PWM) excitation is challenging since the magnetic-field response depends on both the instantaneous flux density and the preceding magnetisation trajectory. Although sequence-to-sequence models enable waveform prediction, existing studies have not jointly addressed how much magnetic history is required, how saturation region should be handled, and how trained models can be adapted to unseen materials. To address these gaps, this paper presents MagLearn 2, a condition-aware, short-window LSTM-based sequence-to-sequence framework for reconstructing the future H(t) response from the historical B(t) and H(t) trajectories. A saturation-aware auxiliary module selectively replaces saturation-dominated predictions within the complete waveform forecast. In a representative saturated 3C90 case, the auxiliary module reduces the sequence-level relative RMSE from 67.84% to 9.19%. To understand how much the history samples contributes to the predictions, an occlusion-based sensitivity analysis is conducted to quantifies the contribution of magnetic history and reveals that that the information most relevant to prediction is concentrated near the forecast boundary. In the independent evaluation for MagNet Challenge II, the proposed framework's best-performing model achieved the lowest reported average RMSE to date on the sequence-prediction task at 2.2%.

papers.title_en: Envelope Characterizations for Trajectories of the Ćuk Converter
papers.evidence: 电力电子变换器的稳定性分析
papers.tldr: 本文针对时间与状态依赖开关控制下的Ćuk变换器，全面刻画了其轨迹包络线的边界与系统稳定性。研究通过建立差分方程准确计算了系统响应的包络边界，并构造李雅普诺夫函数证明了系统在连续与断续导通模式下的稳定性，多组仿真验证了理论的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, a complete characterization of the stability and the boundaries of the envelopes for trajectories of the Ćuk converter is provided in the cases of time and state-dependent switching. In particular, difference equations are developed and used to compute boundaries for the system's response envelopes as well as Lyapunov functions to show the system's stability in both continuous and discontinuous regimes of operation. Each case is illustrated by multiple simulations.
